item.title: WVU Society of Women's Engineers hosts girls STEM day
item.description: The WVU Society of Women's Engineers welcomed elementary aged girls to campus Saturday and allowed them to participate in hands on learning experiences.

item.title: Luncheon raises funds to fight hunger in Monongalia County
item.description: The Empty Bowls project is dedicated to raising funds and awareness, and providing support to local county agencies in the fight against hunger, and the event serves as a way to bring donors and members of the community together to raise money for the local organizations that Empty Bowls Monongalia helps support.

item.title: Gardner Winter Music Festival showcases Appalachian performances
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. - The annual Gardner Winter Music Festival returned to South Middle School in Morgantown, continuing a tradition that dates back more than four decades. Organizers said the event has been bringing traditional Appalachian music, song, and dance to the region since 1979. item.title: Woman threatened to kill child with razor blade in Clarksburg, police say
item.description: A woman has been charged after allegedly threatening to kill a child with a razor blade in Clarksburg.

item.title: Trump says Iran Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is dead, Israel confirms
item.description: Trump called Khamenei “one of the most evil people in history.”

item.title: SWAT Team raid in Harrison County nets nearly 60 grams of fentanyl; 2 arrested
item.description: Two people have been arrested in Harrison County after multiple agencies, including the SWAT Team, executed a search warrant early Friday morning that yielded significant amounts of methamphetamine and fentanyl.

item.title: West Virginia leaders respond to Iran strikes
item.description: The West Virginia Democratic Party Chair Mike Pushkin released his own statement, describing the Iranian regime as brutal and repressive, though saying he is still against President Trump's decision to strike.

item.title: Clarksburg woman arrested after shooting, killing man in Parkersburg
item.description: The female suspect, identified as 19-year-old Claudia Torres of Clarksburg, has been charged with First Degree Murder. She is scheduled to be arraigned in the Wood County Magistrate Court on Saturday morning.

item.title: Vehicle collision shuts down road in Preston County
item.description: The road is currently closed and "will be closed for several hours" The Facebook Post states. Traffic is being detoured via Old Tunnelton Pike and Snyder Loop Road at this time. They are asking people to avoid the area if possible.

item.title: Bridgeport's Reese Allen named next Mountaineer mascot
item.description: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. — West Virginia University senior and Bridgeport native Reese Allen has been named the next Mountaineer mascot. WVU made the announcement during Saturday's men's basketball game against No. 19 BYU inside Hope Coliseum.
